title: PaymentsPaymentCapturedPayload
description: Payload of `payments.payment.captured` version 1. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know.

purpose.description: An order's payment or a Wallet top-up.

order_id.description: The order, for an order's payment.

partner_id.description: The order's Partner; `null` for a top-up.

location_id.description: The order's Location; `null` for a top-up.

method.description: How the rest is paid after the Wallet.

status.description: The payment's status after the change.

version.description: The payment's version after the change, rising with every change.

cause.description: What took the money: a UPI payment (`upi_paid`), a card charged when the Location accepted (`acceptance`), a card that cannot be held charged at checkout (`charged_at_checkout`), the Wallet spent at acceptance (also `acceptance`), a hold charged before it would lapse (`hold_expiring`), cash collected (`cash_collected`), a top-up paid (`top_up`).

provider.description: What the provider took in this capture.

wallet_promotional.description: What was spent from the Wallet's promotional balance.

wallet_paid.description: What was spent from the Wallet's paid balance.

released.description: What of a card hold was given back with this capture, when less was charged than held.

captured_total.description: Everything taken on the payment so far.

attempt_id.description: The provider try, when the provider took money.

provider_reference.description: The provider's reference of that try.

upi_reference.description: The UPI transaction reference, for UPI.

money.description: An amount in minor units with its ISO 4217 currency.

minor_units.description: The amount in the currency's minor unit.
